Discover the official Outlook publication calendar

Source: R/outlook-calendar.R
list_boj_outlook_calendar.Rd

Selects only the Outlook Bank's View column of the MPM schedule. Summary, Minutes and non-Outlook meetings supply no release dates. Bank's View has no fixed publication time; its timestamp is a date-start polling boundary. Full text uses the official next-business-day 14:00 Tokyo rule and BoJ holiday tables. If holiday-year coverage is unavailable its polling bound is marked unconfirmed, rather than asserted as a publication date.

Usage

list_boj_outlook_calendar(
  upcoming_only = TRUE,
  timeout = 30,
  retries = 2L,
  deadline = NULL
)

Arguments

upcoming_only

Keep reports with a Bank's View date or full-text stage still on/after the current Tokyo date/time.

timeout, retries, deadline

Bounded transport settings as in update_boj_outlook().

Value

A data frame with edition hints, publication dates and separate stage polling times, with official source receipts in provenance. The archive's actual edition identity takes precedence over a meeting-month hint.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
list_boj_outlook_calendar(timeout = 10, retries = 0L,
                        deadline = Sys.time() + 30)
} # }
